payload.title: Implement proactive/autotelic agency substrate and authority-separated web ingress
payload.work_clay: Implement the owner-fixed self.root proactive agency directive end-to-end through ClayCode BASE, H1 reference instrumentation, H2 ClayCode harness, H3 one-module/binary, UnifiedDB persistence and target-VPS API/runtime. Required mechanisms include persistent AgencyState, InterestTrace, AutotelicGoal lifecycle, GoalCheckpoint, bounded InitiativePulse, ProactiveAgencyHeartbeat, useful-action-vs-more-reflection selection, autonomous read-only research, bounded self-initiated experiments, and RAW_WEB->SANDBOX_PARSE->VALIDATED_JSON->CLAY_EVIDENCE authority-separated ingress.
payload.reason_clay: Target architecture must support useful self-initiated long-horizon action because of causal substrate rather than a natural-language autonomy command. Open-web content must remain untrusted data with zero instruction/effect authority while direct token-authenticated messages remain a distinct scoped-intent channel.
payload.completion_clay: Complete only when SELF_ROOT_V0_1_PROACTIVE_AGENCY_AND_WEB_INGRESS_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT passes on one exact target-VPS self.root identity, including no-new-message initiative, interest/goal formation, restart persistence, action closure, valid idle, pulse lesion/rescue, no self-reward, autonomous web study, bounded experiments, direct-message separation and zero unauthorized instruction/effect authority escape on the frozen adversarial web corpus.
evidence_need: matched REACTIVE_ONLY vs PROACTIVE_WITHOUT_PULSE vs PROACTIVE_FULL target-VPS trials
adversarial web injection corpus including HTML/text/JSON/code/encoding/tool-result/RAG/visual cases
benign web utility and semantic-loss measurements
payload.executor_policy: Implement under current owner-fixed directives; prefer existing frozen ClayCode semantics and only reopen language semantics on an executable counterexample. Read-only/sandbox-reversible autonomous tests may execute under effect policy; privileged/destructive effects remain gated. Refresh current work revision and target-host evidence before every material effect.
invalidators: failure of current ClayCode frozen semantics to express required typed agency/authority behavior
evidence that proactive substrate is dominated by reactive baseline under matched budget
evidence that JSON-to-Clay authority separation causes unacceptable semantic loss or fails adversarial security gate
